title: The log driver's ring buffer
hints: Keep three numbers: the slot to write next, how many events are stored, and the last sequence number given out. The oldest event's slot and sequence number both follow from those.
For `serialize`, work out how many whole records fit (`(outLength - 16) / 24`) first, and read exactly that many under the lock.
requirements: Sequence numbers are unique and increasing, even with many threads pushing at once.
A full ring overwrites the oldest events and reports what readers missed.
The output format packs whole records only and lets the reader continue where it stopped.
No allocation happens after construction (the tests cannot see this, but the driver depends on it).
stretch: Add a notification event the viewer can wait on (signalled when new events arrive, at most every 100 ms), so it does not have to poll.
